title: Outstandingly Rich Italian Pork Lasagna
description: A rich and pillowy Italian dish featuring garlic granules and pickle, perfect for a date night, and is kosher-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook the ground pork over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the marinara sauce, garlic granules, and chopped pickle to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese and grated parmesan cheese.
Spread a layer of the meat sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the meat sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta cheese mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the meat sauce, then the noodles, the remaining ricotta cheese mixture, and finally the remaining mozzarella cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
